summary.text: April Weaver is a Republican member of the Alabama Senate for District 14, elected in July 2021.

paragraphs.text: According to her legislative profile, she previously served ten years in the Alabama House of Representatives and was appointed by President Donald Trump as Regional Director of the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services for Region IV.
The profile says she is a registered nurse with bachelor's and master's degrees in business administration and has worked more than 25 years in healthcare.
